I am an old woman, and my bones are not strong like before, but I know this land well. My children and grandchildren help me on the farm, and we have some cows and goats, so I will put manure on this rice plot like I have always done. I will also try to get a small bag of urea from the voucher program to help the rice grow strong, but I cannot afford much. We will do the planting, weeding, and harvesting ourselves, though I will need to hire some young men from the village to help with the heavy digging at the start and maybe at harvest time.
